The '''Nanth'ri Route''', also known as the '''Nanth'ri Trade Route''', was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace trade route]] that was frequently the location of [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] attacks by [[Celis Mott]] and his [[Nanth'ri Pirates]].
